reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD geometry is a 2D sketch/contour model plus OCCT solids; there is no portable 3D NURBS curve record.
Offsets are 2D bulge polylines delegated to cavalier_contours; the service is tied to contour compensation, not to a NURBS curve record.
Fillet works on sketch entity Ids and a shared sketch vertex; it is not a portable line/NURBS corner service.
Blend/fillet is an OCCT solid-edge adapter with QymCAD's naming model; it does not operate on curve records.

rationale: QymCAD's sketch fillet/offset model edits 2D sketch entities by Id, not a portable NURBS pole/grip record; no code is reused.
not_reused: QymCAD sketch/model Id state and its 2D contour representation.
QymCAD native/OCCT adapter types; this slice keeps portable safe-Rust records only.
l3_scope: Portable grip description (poles, Greville edit points, knots) and exact pole move/insertion for lines and NURBS records.
